import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Load dataset
titanic = pd.read_csv('data/titanic.csv')

# Set style
sns.set(style="whitegrid")

# Create a bar plot for survival rate by class and sex
plt.figure(figsize=(10, 6))
sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', data=titanic, ci=None)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex on the Titanic')
plt.legend(title='Sex')

# Save the plot
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)

import pandas as pd

import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Set style

# Create a bar plot for survival rate by class and sex

sns.barplot(x='pclass', y='survived', hue='sex', data=titanic, ci=None)

# Add labels and title
plt.xlabel('Passenger Class')
plt.ylabel('Survival Rate')
plt.title('Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex on the Titanic')
